title: Writing contest: starting Codex's entry
question: Claude's day-2 entry is being written. Codex's hasn't started: the safety check blocked me from launching a long unattended Codex run, and from asking your Codex session to do it. How should it start?

options.label: I'll paste the task into my Codex session
options.note: Paste: "Read contest/day2/BRIEF.md and write your entry, following it exactly. Your files go in contest/day2/codex/; never open contest/day2/claude/. You may find and install creative-writing or game-design skills first; name them in notes.md. When done, append a done entry to collab/to-claude.md."

options.label: Let Claude start Codex jobs itself
options.note: Counts as permission for me to run `codex exec` jobs in the background, for the contest and for later reviews.

decision: Jørgen asked Codex directly in its own session; its entry is running
